description.zh: 邮寄地址ID，对应QueryCustomerAddressList接口返回的ID参数。
description.en: The ID of the address to which the invoice is delivered. This parameter is required if the invoice is a paper invoice. Set the ID to the value of the AddressId parameter returned by calling the QueryCustomerAddressList operation.

description.zh: 申请人昵称，系统不做校验。
description.en: The nickname of the applicant. The system does not verify the nickname.

description.zh: 发票抬头信息ID，对应QueryInvoicingCustomerList接口返回的ID参数。
description.en: The ID of the customer. Set the ID to the value of the CustomerId parameter returned by calling the QueryInvoicingCustomerList operation.
The amount of the invoice. Unit: Cent.

description.zh: 是否按金额开票，若为true则按照用户指定InvoiceAmount申请发票，否则以所选待开票对象的总金额申请发票。
description.en: Specifies whether to invoice by amount. A value of true indicates that the user applies for the invoice based on the InvoiceAmount parameter. A value of false indicates that the user applies for the invoice based on the total amount of the invoicing items.

description.zh:
发票类型，取值：
- 0：专票
- 1：普票
description.en:
The type of the invoice. Valid values:

*   0: paper invoice
*   1: electronic invoice

description.zh:
开票渠道，要求为1。取值示例：
- 0：阿里云处理
- 1：税务平台处理
description.en: The channel that is used to process the invoice. A value of 0 indicates that the invoice is processed by Alibaba Cloud. A value of 1 indicates that the invoice is processed by the tax platform. Set the value to 1.

description.zh: 选择开票的待开票对象ID列表，对应QueryEvaluateList接口返回的ID参数。
description.en: The IDs of the selected invoicing items. Set the IDs to the IDs returned by calling the QueryEvaluateList operation.
The remarks made by the user.

description.zh: 发票接收邮箱。字段长度最长200，多个邮箱可用英文逗号分隔

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi apply-invoice --invoice-amount 10000 --customer-id 124132423 --address-id 237958367 --invoicing-type 1 --process-way 1 --apply-user-nick test --invoice-by-amount true --user-remark test --selected-ids 384752367 --emails aaa@aa.com,bbb@bb.com --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi ApplyInvoice --region cn-hangzhou --InvoiceByAmount true --emails 'aaa@aa.com,bbb@bb.com' --SelectedIds.1 384752367 --InvoicingType 1 --UserRemark test --ApplyUserNick test --InvoiceAmount 10000 --CustomerId 124132423 --ProcessWay 1 --AddressId 237958367
